content.short: Flash is the easiest way for businesses, creators, and merchants to accept Bitcoin.
content.description: Flash makes it effortless for businesses to accept Bitcoin—fast, intuitive, and ready to use in minutes. Built for businesses, creators, and merchants, it supports product sales, donations, and subscriptions. By removing the complexity of Bitcoin payments, Flash delivers a seamless checkout experience and integrates with Shopify, WooCommerce, and other major platforms for a smooth, widely accessible payment option across storefronts. This solution lets merchants add Bitcoin payments without heavy setup or technical hurdles, expanding flexible options for customers.
content.meta: Flash is the easiest way for businesses to accept Bitcoin. Discover Flash and other Web3 Wallet Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
